We have x + y = 20 and 2x + 4y = 70.
Multiply the first equation by 2: 2x + 2y = 40.
Subtract this from the second equation: (2x + 4y) - (2x + 2y) = 70 - 40 => 2y = 30 => y = 15.
Then x = 20 - y = 20 - 15 = 5.
So there are 5 chickens.
